text: Vicky Foods, a family-owned Spanish food company, has agreed with Adam Foods to acquire the Panrico bakery brand for the Spanish and Portuguese markets.
short: Vicky Foods acquired the Panrico bakery brand.

source.name: Vicky Foods: 'Vicky Foods adquiere Panrico y refuerza su liderazgo en el mercado del pan en Iberia'
source.quote: ha alcanzado un acuerdo con Adam Foods para la adquisición de la emblemática marca de panadería, Panrico
